segments.motivation: Organizing, tracking, and coordinating team projects to meet deadlines and objectives.
Understanding their work assignments, managing their personal workload, and contributing effectively to team goals.
Standardizing workflows, automating routine tasks, and improving overall operational efficiency and consistency.

tasks.purpose: with clear owners and due dates

tasks.context: using various views (e.g., list, board, timeline)

tasks.purpose: to identify delays and ensure deadlines are met
to save time and standardize work
to balance assignments and prevent over-allocation

benefits.claim: Provides clear insight into who is doing what, by when, and the overall status of projects.
Facilitates seamless teamwork in a shared environment, ensuring everyone has consistent context and connecting work to strategic objectives.
Increases productivity by automating routine tasks and standardizing workflows, allowing teams to focus on higher-value work.

frictions.claim: The extensive feature set can be overwhelming for individuals or teams new to comprehensive project management software.
Tailoring projects, workflows, and custom fields to specific team requirements can be time-consuming to set up effectively.
If not implemented thoughtfully, the level of detail required for tasks and reporting can lead to a feeling of being bogged down.
